# Copilot Instructions

All shared guidance lives in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Follow it in full - it is platform-neutral and applies identically to GitHub Copilot (in Visual Studio Code or on GitHub.com) and to Claude Code. Read it before making changes.

It also indexes this repository's procedures, which live one per directory under `.claude/skills/` as a `SKILL.md`. Claude Code loads those on its own; Copilot has no such mechanism, so read the matching file directly before starting one of those tasks - the table in AGENTS.md says which task each covers. Each is the authority on its procedure, and AGENTS.md does not restate them.

Apply this guidance on every request - large or small - even when the user does not explicitly ask for it.
